item.title: China is stepping up its Iran war diplomacy ahead of Trump's summit with Xi
item.description: China’s diplomatic role in the Iran war has come into sharper focus after talks between Chinese and Iranian foreign ministers on Wednesday, days before U.S. President Donald Trump is expected to meet his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping

item.title: Police say Australian women with alleged IS ties face charges on return from Syria
item.description: Police say a number of Australian women with alleged ties to Islamic State group militants face charges if they return from Syria

item.title: Fire at a shopping center in Iran kills 8 people and injures dozens
item.description: Tehran's emergency service department says a fire in a shopping center near the Iranian capital has killed eight people and injured 40
